variants.about: Files and commands on, Desktop off, read-write, multi-agent off, one root, control actions off.
Command execution off: find replaces exec_command/write_stdin.
Every file capability off, commands on.
Read-only mode on with every capability granted.
Multi-agent on (agents tool), unattributed calls not allowed.
Allow unattributed calls on: plan and code mode with a request-scoped caller (x-request-id).
Screen, control and both clipboard permissions on; calls only against the recorder-owned window.
Screen only: Desktop read tools without input or clipboard.
Control API actions allowed; only refusals are recorded.
